objective: general-purpose stiff/oscillatory ODE solver with effective automatic selection and small-host performance

nodes.title: Preserve and bind actual local raw
actions: read stop packet and actual local raw/source/binary/reference manifests
create-only durable raw backup after capacity check; retain originals
acceptance: actual raw location and hashes
unavailable files remain missing, not synthesized

nodes.title: Trace h limits and phase errors
nodes.routing: low-cost extraction; Astra ultra only for unresolved mechanism
actions: case5, KS, chirp, gyromotion, Robertson and one nonstiff control
record requested/trial/proposed h, error, acceptance, clipping, method, per-path cost; short bounded runs only when absent
acceptance: same-state/time matched traces
separate stability/accuracy/controller/output/domain/runtime causes

nodes.title: Persistent method sessions
nodes.routing: workhorse low/medium; focused Astra ultra for validity proof
actions: retain DOPRI PI/FSAL/workspace and native implicit controller across windows
invalidate caches on method/model/chart epoch changes
replay-safe checkpoints and all attempted-work accounting
acceptance: single uninterrupted versus windowed solve state/counter consistency under fixed conditions
no stale FSAL after implicit advancement
reduced same-cap regret on untouched evaluation cases

nodes.title: Physical norm and chart providers
nodes.routing: Astra ultra + physmath for derivation; workhorse implementation
actions: dynamic physical norm for nonlinear/time-dependent charts
phase rounding and physical velocity transport
carrier residual exactness/epoch registration; non-equivariant and noncommuting controls
acceptance: full original state accuracy across time grid
reject changed or unsupported chart declarations
positive same-cap cost result with all setup counted

nodes.title: Measured method choice and re-evaluation
nodes.routing: workhorse; Astra ultra only for new decision theorem
actions: calibrate RHS/JVP/solve work proxy against actual per-window wall time
cap shadow overhead, update cost on epoch drift, separate probe timing from timing repeats
declare structural capabilities first, then observed method fitness; no stiffness claim from h alone
acceptance: same checkpoint actual candidate and relevant alternative replay
failed/less accurate alternatives excluded
initial rotation overhead measured and reduced without worsening stiff tests

nodes.title: Extend execution adapter beyond ensembles
actions: coarse chunks and persistent pools for large-grid RHS
stage parallelism only if observed critical-path gain and sufficient work
calibration economics before probing; sunk cost excluded from future dispatch; include total overhead in report
acceptance: ordered physical output parity
no nested oversubscription
warmup/raw pair and heldout drift recorded
single-item no pool/calibration regression remains valid

nodes.title: Selection-centred evaluation
actions: selected path plus one relevant challenger per checkpoint
separate tuning and unseen holdout intervals
use selection_window.schema.json and analyze_selection.py; external VODE/DVODE/diffsol/Julia controls retain own explicit source maps
acceptance: qualified observed cost ratio and failure taxonomy
calibration/setup/probe/transition charged exactly once
no full Cartesian campaign or NCP

nodes.title: Scoped release decision and publication
nodes.routing: low-cost synthesis; one precise review if new material risk
actions: publish code, small raw evidence and human/machine findings
promote only demonstrated feature scope; retain specialized cases and unresolved ones
acceptance: exact source/tree/build tests reported
no blanket production promotion from pilot
local handoff return and durable raw pointers
